versions.content: CanIf shall transmit L-PDUs or Transmit Requests stored in the Transmit L-PDU Buffers in priority order (see [12, ISO 11898-1:2015]) per each HTH . CanIf shall not differentiate between L-PDUs and Transmit Requests .
